notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

An update for the demo version of the game has been published, here is the changelog:

[list]
[*] Bug Fix: The game should now work for all different screen resolutions
[*] Changed the way the tiles appear at the start of each level
[*] Automatic level transition, no more "Next level" popup
[*] Added Settings screen:
[list]
[*] Audio options: Disable Music/Sound and Change Music/Sound volume
[*] Graphical options: Full Screen, Borderless, Windowed mode and multi-screen support
[*] Misc options: Disable Hints popup
[/list]
[/list]

Note: Due to how settings are stored, your progression might be lost if you played the demo before the changes. Apologies for that, and it shouldn't happen again in the future.
